note: Greene County Conservation park, 240 acres with a 50-acre lake NE of Jefferson; the shoreline is nearly level with the water. Swimming beach, disc golf, roller rink and boat rental run by a separate concessionaire. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $25 electric ($10 primitive), showers and dump with their dates, 16 reservable + 98 FCFS on MyCountyParks. Added count 120 electric. Park 'open all year' isn't a campground statement, so season left unset; 50-amp confirmed. Pin on the lake, ~150 m from each row.
flags: Waterfront 'lakefront' stands for the west row. On imagery at 42.0658,-94.2898 the west-shore pads run with their spurs toward the lake, the road behind them, and ~10-20 m of open grass to the rip-rap shore; I see no road or day use between. The east-shore row is the reverse: pads on the east side of the park road, with the road between them and the water, so `lakeview` at best for those. County text: 'a 50 acre lake lined with campsites'. Which site numbers are in the west row stayed unread: the page's 'Map of Spring Lake' has no plain-HTML target.

Pin 42.0655,-94.2890 sits in the lake itself between the two rows; the west row's centre is about 42.0657,-94.2908. The pin is within 150 m of both rows so no re-pin needed unless a land point is preferred.
Phone: the park page gives 'Spring Lake: 515-386-2313' (stored), while the reservation contract gives 'Spring Lake Park ... Phone: 515-738-5069'. Both county-published.
The $10 primitive is a 'tent area ... per tent', so base stays $25.
